clips.title: The story
paras: In the northern Barrens, Horde rogues face a Venture Company outpost that tests stealth, theft, and combat. They infiltrate an oil tower, kill Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix, and take a potent chemical brew for the Shattered Hand.

North of the Sludge Fen oil rigs, the Venture Company keeps an isolated drilling tower. Taskmaster Fizzule, a Shattered Hand operative posing as a Venture Company supervisor, orders rogues to rely on underworld craft instead of an open assault. He asks them to pick the key from Foreman Silixiz and keep it for him. Then they climb past workers and sentries changed by the tower’s experiments.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You will need to steal the tower key from Foreman Silixiz, friend. Once you've got the key in your possession, hold on to it - I may need it later.
Remember, the poison has weakened everything in this tower. Use your abilities to bring chaos and destruction to its inhabitants. Slay them all—show no mercy!
Once everything inside lays in a bloodied heap, pick Gallywix's lockbox and steal the cache of Zanzil's mixture held inside. Take both the head of Gallywix and the mixture to Shenthul in Orgrimmar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you to report, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Poor Fizzule, he was a good agent—one of our best. Alas, it is the price we pay, friend. Being a field agent of the Shattered Hand is dangerous work.
You have performed your duty well, adventurer. It would be a shame if you did not live to serve us again.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
